INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY MEETING 6PM
INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY MEETING 6PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, JUNE 04, 2013
09:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 47
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. JOINT CALL TO ORDER OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY.
Mayor/Chair Ledford called the meetings to order at 6:00 p.m.
2. JOINT ROLL CALL: MAYOR/CHAIR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM/VICE CHAIR/CHAIR PRO TEM LACKEY, COUNCILMEMBER/MEMBER/DIRECTOR BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, AND HOFBAUER Mayor to Open Housing Authority Meeting and Take Roll Call Separately
Present - Mayor/Chair Ledford
Present - Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair/Chair Pro Tem Lackey
Present - Councilmember/Member/Director Bettencourt
Present - Councilmember/Member/Director Dispenza
Present - Councilmember/Member/Director Hofbauer
Mayor/Chair Ledford opened Housing Authority Meeting and took Housing Authority roll call at this time.
3. JOINT BUDGET WORK SESSION AND DISCUSSION OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, HOUSING AUTHORITY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY:
3.1 Review and discussion of the City Council, Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Industrial Development Authority, Palmdale Airport Authority, Palmdale Civic Authority, and Palmdale Financing Authority Budgets for Fiscal Year 2013/2014. (Staff Reference: City Manager/Executive Director Childs and Department Heads and Managers).
There is no staff report for this item.
For detailed information on this item, pleas refer to City Council Meeting Minutes for June 5, 2013, 6:00 p.m.
4. JOINT PUBLIC COMMENTS OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE CITY COUNCIL, SUCCESSOR AGENCY, HOUSING AUTHORITY, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE AIRPORT AUTHORITY, PALMDALE CIVIC AUTHORITY, AND PALMDALE FINANCING AUTHORITY:
None.
5. ADJOURNMENT to June 5, 2013 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
Complete packets can be viewed at City Hall, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite A, Palmdale, California; and the Main Library, located at 700 East Palmdale Boulevard, Palmdale, California. You can also view the Agendas and Staff Reports on our website at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
Thank you for attending your Industrial Development Authority meeting. If you have any questions or wish to know more about the City, please call (661) 267-5100, Monday through Thursday, 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., closed every Friday.
Mayor/Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 7:20 p.m. to June 5, 2013 at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Suite B, Palmdale, California.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 7th day of August 2013.
___________________________________
James C. Ledford, Jr., Chair
